paragraphs: Yehudah of Chutzi asked R. Yosi ben Chalafta whence one town's life takes precedence over another town's life. He called R. Avudramos, etc. Yehudah had hidden in a cave for three days to understand the reason: Jerusalem Sheviit, chapter 8, halakhah 5. Last chapter of Nedarim, halakhah 1, has of Hutza. [The checked Nedarim text calls R. Yosi’s son Abba.]
